summary: Full testing of 5 new features for Commercial Real Estate CRM. Backend: 9/9 tests passed. Frontend: All 5 features verified working via Playwright testing - Asset type filter on Map, Contact info in side panel, Asking price comma formatting, Tag filter on Contacts, Click-to-edit contact behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: MapView.js: Asset type filter dropdown (data-testid='asset-type-filter') correctly filters deals by asset type
MapView.js: Contact info section (lines 1762-1815) displays linked contacts with name, email, phone from contact_deal_links
MapView.js: formatNumberInput function (lines 18-28) properly formats asking price with commas
Contacts.js: Tag filter dropdown (data-testid='filter-tag') alongside type and status filters
Contacts.js: Table row onClick (line 703) calls handleOpenEdit directly to open edit panel instead of details panel
seed_data_creation: Test users created during frontend and backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 new features fully tested and working: 1) Map tab has 'All Asset Types' dropdown in top controls that filters deal markers. 2) Map deal side panel shows Contacts section with linked contact name/email/phone from contact_deal_links. 3) Asking price in side panel shows with comma formatting (e.g., 2,500,000). 4) Contacts page has 'All Tags' dropdown in filter bar alongside All Types and All Statuses. 5) Clicking contact row in table or card view opens Edit panel directly (not details panel). Backend APIs all working - /api/deals, /api/deals/{id} returns contact_deal_links, /api/contacts with tag_id filter, /api/contacts/tags.

feature_1_asset_type_filter.details: Dropdown with data-testid='asset-type-filter' shows All Asset Types + Office/Retail/Industrial/Multifamily/Land/Mixed Use/Other options

feature_2_contact_info_side_panel.details: Contact info section displays dealContacts array extracted from contact_deal_links API response. Shows name, email, phone with icons.

feature_3_asking_price_comma_formatting.details: formatNumberInput() adds commas to asking price. Example: 2500000 displays as 2,500,000

feature_4_contacts_tag_filter.details: Tag filter dropdown (data-testid='filter-tag') in filter bar shows 'All Tags' + user-created tags

feature_5_click_to_edit_contact.details: Table row onClick and card onClick both call handleOpenEdit(contact) which sets showAddPanel=true with editingContact set

backend_api_deals.details: GET /api/deals returns deals list with success/deals/count structure

backend_api_deals_single.details: GET /api/deals/{id} returns deal with contact_deal_links array containing contacts info (name/email/phone)

backend_api_contacts.details: GET /api/contacts with tag_id filter works correctly

backend_api_contacts_tags.details: GET /api/contacts/tags returns tags list for the user
